This episode focuses on three evidentiary threads. First, viewer-sourced analysis of broken glass shards recovered from the SUV backseat floor is presented: a viewer email identifies a USB icon on a shard, aligning it with the Rode Rode mic used by Charlie Kirk. The host treats this as supporting the "rigged microphone" theory. Second, Brian Harpole's account of the hospital transport and ER events is dissected for internal contradictions: the open car door at high speed, 36 ft of dressing on a six-minute ride, his claim to have jumped on the gurney to cut Charlie's shirt, and his description of Frank Turek praying in the backseat. Third, the Daily Wire's reported $100M strategic investment and IPO push is summarized from a Semafor article, paired with audio from Dave Rubin's appearance on Jubilee showing him unable to defend Trump economic metrics and asserting the Gaza war is over.

The episode also includes discussion of Frank Turek's stated change into scrubs, blood-mustle in the backseat photos, a viewer email from a source described as high-ranking in a police department regarding DA authorization for releasing evidence to Erika Kirk, and additional commentary on the dissociative identity disorder (DID) theory applied to Erika Kirk, citing NHS website text. The episode advances the investigative questions of whether Charlie's shirt was cut in the car rather than in the ER, whether explosive residue evidence was destroyed through the disposal of clothing, and how various attendees ended up in scrubs.

Structurally, this is an evidentiary accumulation episode: it cross-examines Brian Harpole's story using viewer-sourced medical expert comments, car interior photos, and Terryl Farnsworth footage. It also serves as a venue for discussing the Daily Wire's financial decline as a secondary topic with no direct connection to the Kirk case.

blocks.header: **C-10310** USB Logo Identified on Car Glass Shard
blocks.label: USB Logo Identified on Car Glass Shard

lines.v: A viewer email identifies a USB logo on one of the glass shards recovered from the SUV backseat floor, rotated to align with the Rode mic USB icon shown in a promotional image.
Independent forensic examination of shard images for matching geometry to a Rode mic USB icon; obtain original Rode Rode mic reference images for side-by-side comparison.

lines.v: Brian Harpole states in his account that he got on top of Charlie on a gurney in the ER and cut his white "Freedom" shirt off to enable defibrillator placement.
Obtain full unedited Brian Harpole interview transcript; corroborate against any ER surveillance footage (if not destroyed) and ER staff testimony.

blocks.label: Brian Harpole States Car Door Was Open During Hospital Transport

lines.v: Brian Harpole states that the car door behind him remained open during the hospital ride because Charlie's leg was hanging out, and that Rick Cutler physically held Brian in place to prevent him from falling out.
Cross-reference with dash-cam / traffic-cam / police body cam footage to verify door-open configuration.

lines.v: Brian Harpole states they were going "60 80 100" on the way to the hospital; the host quotes him as saying "60, 80, 100 mph weaving through the streets."
Cross-reference with traffic-cam and police-body-cam timestamps to estimate actual travel speed.

blocks.label: Brian Harpole States He Used 36 ft of Dressing on Charlie's Neck

lines.v: Brian Harpole states he applied approximately 36 ft (12 yd) of dressing, four 4x4s, and two hemostatic 4x4s to Charlie's neck wound during the short ride.
Compare dressing count against visible dressing/pack debris in car interior photos; obtain medical supply packaging for roll length verification.

blocks.label: Brian Harpole States Frank Turek Was Praying in Backseat During Transport

lines.v: In a clip the host plays, Brian Harpole says Frank Turek was praying out loud during the ride; the host says that, according to Brian, Frank was simply praying in the backseat and asks why he could not lean over and close the door.
Obtain Frank Turek's own account of his activity during the ride; identify any audio recording that could capture in-car speech.

blocks.header: **C-10324** Brian Harpole States Rick Cutler Physically Held Him During Transport
blocks.label: Brian Harpole States Rick Cutler Physically Held Him During Transport

lines.v: Brian Harpole states that Rick Cutler reached across and held onto him so he would not fall out of the moving SUV while he attended to Charlie.
Cross-reference with Rick Cutler's own testimony if available; review photo evidence of Rick Cutler's clothing for blood patterns inconsistent with this holding posture.

blocks.header: **C-10348** Frank Turek States He Changed into Hospital Scrubs
blocks.label: Frank Turek States He Changed into Hospital Scrubs

lines.v: In a clip the host plays, Frank Turek says he was in scrubs at the hospital because 'I didn't want her to see any of that' about his clothes; the host adds that this means not wanting Erika to see the blood on them.
Identify how and where scrubs were obtained; determine whether scrubs were preserved as evidence or returned.

blocks.label: Host Says Frank Turek Threw Away His Original Clothing

lines.v: In a clip the host plays, Frank Turek says he was in scrubs at the hospital because 'I didn't want her to see any of that'; the host says he admits elsewhere that he threw his clothes away.
Locate any recording where Frank Turek directly states disposal; cross-reference with hospital chain-of-custody records for patient-adjacent personal property.

blocks.label: Host Says Terryl Farnsworth Video Shows Frank Turek Entering SUV Through Trunk

blocks.label: Car Backseat Photos Show Blood Wipe Marks on Leather

blocks.label: Host Says Car Backseat Photos Show Blood Marks on Brown Paper / Uber Bag

Forensic testing of the bag (if available) for blood type, DNA, and explosive residue.

blocks.label: Single 4x4 Dressing Pack Visible in Car Floor Photos
